sample_content_texts: ENGAGING TODAY
Activities built from one resident's own life.
Fill in what you know about them, pick the pages you want, and you'll get a printable large-print packet using their hometown, their family's names, their work, and the things they loved.
What Cognicopia gives you
Informed by the research
The activities draw on published research on reminiscence, cognitive stimulation and print for older eyes. The Research Center sums up each study, with its sources and its limits.
Cognicopia is developed and published with dedication to providing dignified, personalized reminiscence and cognitive engagement resources for memory care.
THE PACKET TOOL
Make a packet
Nothing you type here is sent anywhere. The packet is made on this computer and saved straight to your downloads. No resident information ever reaches us.
Choose a general archetype for a temporary packet. No profile is saved and no resident name is used.
Active resident
No saved resident profiles yet. Press New Profile to make one; it takes about five minutes and is saved only on this computer.

Instant Soothe opens two quick choices, a care level and a theme, then prints a fresh one-to-three page calming packet made for that moment. It uses the active resident's level and name when one is chosen, and needs no profile when none is.
📅 Monthly Activity Bundle
One PDF with a personalized packet for every resident you choose. Made entirely on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
Building your monthly bundle…
Keep this tab open. You can cancel at any time; nothing is saved until it finishes.
Some of these residents are already saved
Residents who are not saved yet are imported either way.
Profile Packet Builder
Quick printable pages made from the active resident's profile: their work, hobbies, people and favorite years, in large high-contrast print. Topics to avoid are always left out.
